I added item removal, discount codes and a total-price function to `Shop.Cart` in `lib/shop/cart.ex`, plus tests for each. All 15 tests pass and `mix credo --strict` reports no issues.

- **`remove_item(cart, sku, quantity)`** takes units off an item. If you remove as many units as the cart holds, or more, the item is removed. Removing a SKU that isn't in the cart leaves the cart unchanged.
- **`apply_discount(cart, code)`** takes the code as a string and returns either `{:ok, cart}` or an error
